detail.longDescription:
DevOps mobile app.

This app lets you access many of the features offered by DevOps from your smartphone, with a nice UI that makes working with your daily DevOps tasks even more enjoyable.

Features:
- Login with Microsoft (or with your Personal Access Token)
- Manage your work items. Specifically, you can create, edit and delete a work item, add comments and add attachments
- Manage your team's boards and sprints
- Manage your pipelines. You can cancel and rerun a pipeline, and you can also see the pipeline's logs
- Manage your projects, repos and commits (with file diff)
- Manage your pull requests. You can approve, reject and complete a pull request, and you can also add comments to it.
- Switch between multiple organizations

Disclaimer: this is not an official Microsoft product.
